records.name: Actor
records.description: A person, role or persona that interacts with the system.

records.name: External System
records.description: A system outside the design boundary.

records.name: Business Domain
records.description: A cohesive business area containing related capabilities and services.

records.name: Logical Service
records.description: A technology-neutral business or application responsibility.

properties.label: Primary responsibility
properties.description: The business or application responsibility owned by this service.

records.name: Domain Event
records.description: A fact published by one responsibility and consumed by others.

records.name: Deployable Unit
records.description: An independently buildable and deployable application unit.

properties.label: Stateless
properties.description: Whether runtime instances can be replaced without local state loss.

properties.label: Independent deployment
properties.description: Whether this unit can be deployed without coordinated release.

records.name: Application API
records.description: A synchronous or asynchronous application interface.

properties.label: Publicly exposed
properties.description: Whether the interface is reachable outside the trusted boundary.

records.name: Application Module
records.description: A cohesive internal module within a deployable application.

records.name: Worker Component
records.description: A background processor, consumer or scheduled application component.

records.name: Identity & Access Control
records.description: Authentication and authorization responsibility.

records.name: Message Broker Capability
records.description: Vendor-neutral reliable message transport and routing capability.

properties.label: Sensitive payloads
properties.description: Whether messages may contain confidential or restricted data.

records.name: Relational Data Service
records.description: Vendor-neutral relational persistence capability.

properties.label: Transactional
properties.description: Whether multi-record ACID transactions are required.

records.name: Document Data Service
records.description: Vendor-neutral document-oriented persistence capability.

records.name: Distributed Cache Capability
records.description: Low-latency distributed cache capability.

records.name: API Management Capability
records.description: Gateway, policy and lifecycle management capability for APIs.

records.name: Observability Capability
records.description: Metrics, logs, traces and alerting capability.

records.name: Technology Product
records.description: A specific vendor product or managed service.

records.name: Runtime
records.description: A process, container, function or execution runtime.

records.name: Deployment Node
records.description: A physical or virtual execution node.

records.name: Region
records.description: A cloud or data-centre region boundary.

records.name: Availability Zone
records.description: An isolated failure domain within a region.

records.name: Network Zone
records.description: A network or trust boundary.

records.name: Managed Data Store
records.description: A concrete database or managed persistence product.

records.name: Managed Event Streaming

records.name: Secure API Service
records.description: Deployable API, access-control responsibility and service boundary starter.
whenToUse: Starting an externally or internally exposed application service.
whenToQuestion: Pure event-consumer workloads with no request interface.
mitigations: High availability and cached policy decisions

records.name: Reliable Event Processing
records.description: Producer, event broker and consumer starter with failure-handling obligations.
whenToUse: Decoupled processing and independently scalable consumers.
whenToQuestion: Simple request-response operations requiring immediate consistency.
obligations: Define retry, dead-letter and replay strategy

records.name: Resilient External Integration
records.description: Gateway and resilience controls for a remote third-party dependency.
whenToUse: Any important synchronous external dependency.

records.name: Multi-Zone Deployment
records.description: Region, availability-zone and replicated deployment starter.
whenToUse: Critical services with explicit availability and recovery objectives.
whenToQuestion: Non-critical workloads where added cost is not justified.
obligations: Define data replication and recovery semantics
